name: moe-gemma4-26b-a4b
note: Sparse MoE Gemma 4 26B A4B decoder block: hidden 2560, 20 query heads / 4 KV heads shared (attention_k_eq_v true), head_dim 256, GeGLU MLP intermediate 8192, num_local_experts 8, num_experts_per_tok 2 (~4B active params/token). Fused QKV = 20*256 + 4*256 = 5120 + 1024 = 6144. o_proj: 20*256 -> 2560. Router: 2560 -> 8 expert logits. Top-k=2 modeled as two sequential expert GeGLU FFNs (each fused up to 2*8192 = 16384, act, down 8192 -> 2560), matching the moe_mixtral_8x7b linear-chain convention (per-token matmul volume; real routing/gather/scatter isn't expressible without branching).
